title: Bifurcations of grazing loops of arbitrary tangent multiplicity in piecewise-smooth systems
summary: In piecewise-smooth differential systems, a hyperbolic limit cycle of a subsystem loses its structural stability if it grazes the switching manifold at a tangent point. Such a cycle is called a grazing loop and in this paper we investigate its bifurcations for arbitrary tangent multiplicity. For the low-multiplicity tangency, the recurrences are comprehensively captured by a functional perturbation with two parameters in previous publications, where the parameters characterize the recurrences near the tangent point and the limit cycle respectively.
